autoresearcheval_panel.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking. severe=no/no-observed means no remaining explicit load-bearing self-critique under the frozen coding rule, not absence of scientific flaws.

candidate_027_refinement.name: issue-ledger review-closure invariant
candidate_027_refinement.new_evidence: This panel adds two recurrent closure failures: (1) a self-implemented comparator is used for causal/mechanistic superiority even after the reviewer says comparator fidelity is unvalidated; (2) a follow-up repair can rule out one explanation such as insufficient training budget while leaving architecture/encoding/nonlinearity alternatives open, so the issue must remain open rather than being relabeled a solved structural ceiling.
candidate_027_refinement.refined_rule: For comparative or mechanistic claims, closure requires a source-validated/matched comparator or an explicitly agnostic claim. A repair that rejects only one member of an alternative-explanation set does not close the issue; promotion remains blocked until the remaining load-bearing alternatives are discriminated, claims are materially narrowed, or the result is rejected.
candidate_027_refinement.scope_guard: Process evidence from one benchmark panel; not a matched intervention proving system-level outcome improvement.
